newsitem.title: UK: Safeway to open round the clock before Xmas.
newsitem.headline: Safeway to open round the clock before Xmas.

text.p: Shoppers at supermarket group Safeway Plc will literally be able to shop around the clock this Christmas as the retailer said on Tuesday it planned to open two stores for more than 33 hours.

Safeway's store in Brent Cross north of London and at Portobello Road in Edinburgh will open from 0830 GMT December 23 until 1800 GMT on December 24. The first 50 shoppers through the doors after midnight get a free cup of tea or coffee and a mince pie. All other Safeway stores will open until 2200 GMT on December 23 and open at 0730 GMT on Christmas eve, but close earlier than usual.
A Safeway spokeswoman said the round the clock opening was just a trial but could be extended to more stores next Christmas if there was sufficient demand.

Rival food retailer ASDA Group Plc was the first of the major supermarkets to open round the clock in the run up to Christmas. An ASDA spokesman said it would be opening four stores from 0600 GMT on December 23 until midnight December 24.
The stores are Clapham in south London, Edinburgh, Watford just north of London and Bristol. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
